title: Carpeta Ciudadana: alert groups and address change (plan only)
blocker: The group reader and preview are implemented. The known write replaces the full calendar without an observed precondition, and the owner deferred address changes.
unblock: Obtain a supported per-group or conditional save protocol and the owner's address decision before capturing the address plan.
notes: e-mail alone switches no alert group on (`/api/v3/preferencias-usuario`
does, not built). The address change service at
`cambiodomicilio.redsara.es/pcd` is not built: the owner deferred any
address change at AEAT/DEHU/Carpeta on 2026-10-11 (it fixes where a future
self-employment counts as located for an aid); build it plan-only when

Carpeta avisos lists group channels and lead times. Carpeta activar-avisos verifies the current configuration and produces a plan that preserves unrelated settings; confirmation is refused before login. The public frontend replaces all groups and provides no observed concurrency protection.
